BatchOperation.description: BatchOperation describes one read operation to execute within a batch request.

id.description: Client-chosen correlation id echoed back in the matching result. Defaults to the operation's zero-based index when omitted.

path.description: Absolute path of any documented GET operation, optionally including a query string — e.g. "/api/market/v1/list-market-quotes" or "/api/intelligence/v1/get-country-risk?country=DE&jmespath=score". Nested batch paths (/api/batch/*) are rejected.

BatchOperationBody.description: BatchOperationBody is the JSON response body returned by one batched operation. It is a free-form object whose shape is defined by the target operation's own response schema (see that operation's entry in this spec).

BatchOperationResult.description: BatchOperationResult is the outcome of one operation in the batch.

error.description: Machine-readable failure reason when no response body is available: invalid_path, nested_batch, timeout, fetch_failed, response_too_large, or invalid_json.

id.description: Correlation id from the request (or the operation's zero-based index when omitted).

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the operation, or 0 when the operation could not be executed at all (see error).

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

ExecuteBatchRequest.description: ExecuteBatchRequest carries the array of operations to execute in bulk.

failed.description: Number of operations that returned a non-2xx status or failed to execute.

succeeded.description: Number of operations that returned an HTTP 2xx status.

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

post.description: ExecuteBatch runs a bulk batch of up to 20 read (GET) operations concurrently in one round trip and returns per-operation statuses and bodies. Use it instead of looping single calls when acting on many items; add a per-operation ?jmespath= projection to keep each body small.
